source_corrections.problem: constant metallic 1 becomes 0 because emission bake is gated on a linked Metallic input
source_corrections.adaptation: Bake constant as well as linked metallic for every intended source material. Local baking production already describes routing constants; preserve that rule.

source_corrections.problem: export_mixamo_fbx resets object matrices without applying conversion and does so on the passed original
source_corrections.adaptation: Use an owned duplicate; preserve world dimensions/bind/parent semantics; verify known-size and axis markers. Never copy reset-transform advice verbatim.

source_corrections.problem: new_model_file discards an unsaved open file when no save path is supplied
source_corrections.adaptation: Refuse unsaved dirty/unowned scene replacement or use a separate background process. Existing execution-and-ownership already protects this.

source_corrections.problem: normal_from_albedo creates width-by-width image although input can be rectangular
source_corrections.adaptation: Support width and height explicitly, test rectangular maps, mark luminance normals as an artistic proxy rather than physical geometry.

source_corrections.problem: np.roll color dilation wraps opposite image borders
source_corrections.adaptation: Use bounded padded neighborhoods; do not bleed an image edge into the opposite edge unless explicitly tiled.

source_corrections.problem: jaw repair clips against world X=0, ignoring head_center.x
source_corrections.adaptation: Use calibrated head-local/midline coordinates; translated/rotated characters require coordinate conversion and measured masks.

source_corrections.problem: only hp.active_material and first Principled drive emission, output Surface assumes a link
source_corrections.adaptation: Resolve intended connected source output per material, handle absent output links, restore all material/selection/settings in finally; existing local bake text already requires this.

source_corrections.problem: seven barycentric samples are heuristic overlap/full-coverage evidence
source_corrections.adaptation: Do not claim zero overlaps or exact containment from samples; use robust triangle polygon intersections or label sampled report and inspect revision-bound images.

source_corrections.problem: pack deletes source scalar maps by default; fill/flatten edit originals and dilate outline 8 pixels
source_corrections.adaptation: Default to new versioned outputs and preserve channels; validate equal dimensions/constants/nonempty sample masks; restrict dilation by owned UV-island masks so adjacent islands are safe.

source_corrections.problem: preservation relies on assert and sibling JSON can overwrite an existing report; UV union does not identify touching-island borders
source_corrections.adaptation: Use explicit runtime exceptions, atomic new output+report validation, finite two-coordinate UV validation; preserve per-island borders when touching/overlapping atlases matter; report mild filtering limits.

source_corrections.problem: parser lacks bounded index/range validation for all views/accessors and extension references; asserts disappear with -O
source_corrections.adaptation: Validate all chunk alignment/order/lengths and reference bounds, supported extensions and buffer ownership; explicit invariant checks and atomic new outputs. Test shared roles, malformed chunk tail, source collision, sparse and preserved bytes.

source_corrections.problem: lights/world created before missing HDRI fails; default HDRI path is macOS Resources layout
source_corrections.adaptation: Resolve/version-check explicit HDRI and view transform before mutation; discover resource path per actual runtime or require explicit path; rollback on error and avoid changing unrelated screens.

source_corrections.problem: skips meshes <=20 polygons, inspects largest only, reports rather than enforces, front_y is not orientation proof; missing Head can crash optional render
source_corrections.adaptation: Inspect manifest object set including low-poly props; compare evaluated dimensions/axis marker/material paths/rig/poses and declared tolerances; treat absent render landmarks as an explicit unavailable check.

source_corrections.problem: assumes first chunk JSON and required optional names; no GLB header/chunk/range validation
source_corrections.adaptation: Use validated GLB parser, optional names, primitive-mode-aware counts and manifest comparisons; presence summaries remain partial.

source_corrections.problem: socket receive unbounded; broken delimiter/EOF not validated as a framed response; protocol hardcoded
source_corrections.adaptation: Document exact Blender Lab protocol distinct from other MCPs. If implementing client use frame bound, timeout and validated status/result shape; default loopback and no automatic config/install changes.

source_corrections.problem: hardcoded python3 assumes external Pillow interpreter; printed SELFTEST OK mostly records counts and no semantic acceptance
source_corrections.adaptation: Use explicit verified host interpreter and native fixture with assertions, failure injection and current artifact hashes; synthetic sphere/three-bone test is not production deformation or visual success.

source_corrections.problem: A-pose dimensions/head/hand thresholds, 5mm voxel and 4 influences are source examples; hard-mask/QuadriFlow claims overgeneralized
source_corrections.adaptation: Calibrate on actual scale/anatomy/pose/target, preserve source and morph/rig contracts, test reachability of region budgets and stress poses. Treat crowd FPS/microsecond data as author observations only.

source_corrections.problem: personal dated preferences and paths are not this user's decisions
source_corrections.adaptation: Retain useful FBX/map/studio branches conditionally; choose format, paths, clothing style and pixel backend from current task. Do not copy source personal FBX or deterministic Python preference as authority.

source_corrections.problem: claims organic geometry requires a generator and conflict majority chooses truth
source_corrections.adaptation: No generator requirement: manual/sculpt/reference workflows remain valid. Resolve inconsistent views from explicit authority/uncertainty, not majority as physical evidence. Projection does not de-light or recover missing detail.
